criteria.statement: The browser creates and lists explicit Bahia-managed Compose deployment units through signed ContextVM environment mutations.
Deployment-unit edits submit the complete explicit unit set with the canonical expected_updated_at revision, preserving unedited units and omitting server-only fields.
Deployment-unit serialization and validation reject duplicate keys, missing revisions, mixed runtimes, non-Bahia-managed ownership, and raw endpoint URLs.
A multi-unit Compose environment requires explicit deployment-unit selection before deployment can continue.
The selected deployment_unit_id is carried unchanged through policy preview and the signed service/deploy request, including the unit tag and resulting intent.
The UI exposes endpoint_ref aliases only and fails closed for invalid unit ownership or targeting without displaying Docker host URLs, certificate paths, keys, or credentials.
